crossRefs.note: “Oh that my anguish were weighed, and all my calamity laid in the balances!
Yahweh, the God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before you.
Yahweh, why do you reject my soul? Why do you hide your face from me?
The cords of death surrounded me, the pains of Sheol got a hold of me. I found trouble and sorrow.
He was despised and rejected by men, a man of suffering and acquainted with disease. He was despised as one from whom…
Yet it pleased Yahweh to bruise him. He has caused him to suffer. When you make his soul an offering for sin, he will…
He who didn’t spare his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how would he not also with him freely give us all…
For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf; so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.
Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who…
He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, that we, having died to sins, might live to righteousness. You were…
Because Christ also suffered for sins once, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring you to God, being…
He came to the disciples, and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “What, couldn’t you watch with me for one hour?
Watch therefore, for you don’t know the day nor the hour in which the Son of Man is coming.
But the end of all things is near. Therefore be of sound mind, self-controlled, and sober in prayer.

parallels.note: He said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here, and watch.”

translations.web: Then he said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here, and watch with me.”
translations.bsb: Then He said to them, “My soul is consumed with sorrow to the point of death. Stay here and keep watch with Me.”
translations.kjv: Then saith he unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful, even unto death: tarry ye here, and watch with me.
translations.asv: Then saith he unto them, My soul is exceeding sorrowful, even unto death: abide ye here, and watch with me.
